name: Bristol Electronics
old_description: Since 1980, Bristol Electronics has been a leading independent stocking distributor.
about:
Bristol Electronics was founded in 1980 in Trevor, Wisconsin, as an independent stocking distributor of electronic components. The company has operated continuously since its inception, building a large inventory and supplier network.

The distributor runs a 30,000-square-foot facility that houses more than one million SKUs and over three billion parts in stock. It offers same-day shipping on more than 250,000 components and leverages a network of over 1,000 global suppliers for non-stock items.

Bristol Electronics serves customers across the electronics sector, including original equipment manufacturers and contract manufacturers who require reliable component supply. The company's sales team draws on decades of industry experience to support procurement needs.

The business emphasizes a customer-first approach, highlighting rapid fulfillment, extensive inventory, and personalized support as its core differentiators. It positions itself as a trusted partner for companies seeking consistent access to electronic parts.
built_on: Experienced sales team with decades of industry knowledge
